thought.text: The dev server is serving the full app with all four map containers, and now I'm testing the production build from `dist/` with a static server.

reasoning_content:
All four map containers (map_1..map_4) and the crosshair elements exist in the served HTML. The webpack CLI works.

Next, let's verify that the production build in dist/ also works. We can serve dist/ with a static server and test it. This will verify the `npm run build` output. Let's quickly test with `python3 -m http.server` or `npx serve`… Actually, python3's http.server is the easiest and doesn't require installation.

Let's serve dist on port 8081 and check whether index.html and bundle.js are loaded.

action.command: cd /workspace/dist && nohup python3 -m http.server 8081 > /tmp/qm_static.log 2>&1 & sleep 3; c1=$(curl -s -o /tmp/qm_d_index.html -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:8081/); c2=$(curl -s -o /tmp/qm_d_bundle.js -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:8081/bundle.js); c3=$(curl -s -o /tmp/qm_d_img.png -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:8081/img/icon_quattromap.png); echo "dist index: $c1 ($(wc -c < /tmp/qm_d_index.html) bytes), dist bundle.js: $c2 ($(wc -c < /tmp/qm_d_bundle.js) bytes), dist img: $c3"; grep -o '<title>[^<]*</title>' /tmp/qm_d_index.html; grep -c '6.391263' /tmp/qm_d_bundle.js

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace/dist && nohup python3 -m http.server 8081 > /tmp/qm_static.log 2>&1 & sleep 3; c1=$(curl -s -o /tmp/qm_d_index.html -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:8081/); c2=$(curl -s -o /tmp/qm_d_bundle.js -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:8081/bundle.js); c3=$(curl -s -o /tmp/qm_d_img.png -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:8081/img/icon_quattromap.png); echo \"dist index: $c1 ($(wc -c < /tmp/qm_d_index.html) bytes), dist bundle.js: $c2 ($(wc -c < /tmp/qm_d_bundle.js) bytes), dist img: $c3\"; grep -o '<title>[^<]*</title>' /tmp/qm_d_index.html; grep -c '6.391263' /tmp/qm_d_bundle.js", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Serve dist/ statically and verify assets respond"}
